messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

建議主軸：Automotive signaling test should prioritize R&S CMX500-based NG eCall / hybrid eCall compliance and PSAP simulation first, then extend to LTE/5G/WLAN signaling, OTA, throughput, audio, protocol and coexistence testing where the vehicle connectivity design requires it [24][25][6].
### 推薦先賣
**NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling validation** is the strongest automotive-specific capability because the R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 supports NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions and PSAP simulation for EN 17240:2024 [25].
**Hybrid eCall compliance** is important because EN 18052 requires combining different transmission paths and protocols so the eCall reliably reaches its destination [10].
**Voice, data, MSD and GNSS-related eCall validation** is important because manufacturers need to validate call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning and intelligible voice quality [10].
**Cellular and WLAN signaling coverage** is important because the R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD and WLAN signaling including 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn and 2x2 MIMO [6].
**OTA signaling** is important where the device or module must be validated through an antenna system, because CMX500 OBT integrations support 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling in MVG OTA systems and 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA, LTE and WLAN testing in Bluetest RTS systems [17][18].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 + eCall software | NG eCall, hybrid eCall, PSAP simulation, voice and data transmission validation | R&S CMX-KA098 for EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 PSAP scenarios; R&S CMX-KA099 for EN 18052:2025 PSAP scenarios; R&S CMX-KA09x updated eCall evaluation solution | This is the clearest automotive signaling fit because the sources directly tie CMX500 to NG eCall and hybrid eCall testing | [24][25] | Pricing, exact bundle contents and supported regional variants are not stated. |
| R&S CMX500 | LTE/5G cellular signaling, application-layer testing, protocol testing and RF measurements | 400 MHz to 8 GHz RF frequency range; LTE, 5G and Wi‑Fi UE signaling; power, frequency, spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER, MIMO, IP throughput, video, audio and protocol test | This covers the main connected-device signaling and measurement layers that automotive communication modules may need | [5] | Test cases, standard release, bandwidth, MIMO layers, OTA/conducted setup, automation interface, limits and uncertainty are not stated [5]. |
| R&S CMX500 | LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN, throughput, BLER, PER, IMS/audio and automation | NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements; LTE signaling and measurements; WLAN signaling and TX measurements; fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, graphical scripting, Python XLAPI and SCPI | This is the broadest single signaling platform in the passages for cellular, WLAN, RF, application and automation work | [6] | Automotive-specific certification scope is only directly stated for eCall, not for every CMX500 cellular/WLAN feature. |
| R&S CMX500 OBT with MVG OTA systems | 4G/5G/WLAN OTA signaling through antenna measurement systems | Full WLAN OTA signaling including Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be; 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling; 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA, RedCap and LTE FDD/TDD support | This is suitable when the automotive device must be evaluated over the air rather than only by conducted RF connection | [1][17] | The passages do not state automotive-specific OTA test cases or vehicle-level antenna chamber requirements. |
| R&S CMX500 OBT with Bluetest RTS | Reverberation-chamber OTA validation for LTE, 5G NR and WLAN | 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA EN-DC, LTE and WLAN a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be with Wi‑Fi 7 320 MHz bandwidth support | This is suitable for multi-technology OTA validation using a single tester and reverberation test system | [18] | The passages do not state automotive-specific pass/fail criteria or car-module certification coverage. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G | R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA098 | Simulate PSAP, validate NG eCall voice and data transmission, and verify EN 17240:2024 implementation compliance | Third-party certification report details are not stated [25]. |
| Hybrid eCall fallback | R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA09x / CMX-KA099 | Validate EN 18052:2025 hybrid eCall behavior where coverage or service quality degradation triggers fallback to classic CS eCall 2G/3G paths | Exact network degradation profiles and pass/fail limits are not stated [10][24]. |
| Automotive connectivity module RF/signaling regression | R&S CMX500 | Cover LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, BLER, PER, throughput, IMS/audio and protocol-level needs | Automotive-specific regression suites are not stated [6]. |
| WLAN-heavy infotainment or connectivity designs | R&S CMX500 | Test WLAN signaling and TX measurements across 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn and 2x2 MIMO | Automotive infotainment-specific conformance coverage is not stated [6]. |
| OTA validation of multi-radio modules | R&S CMX500 OBT with MVG or Bluetest OTA systems | Run 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling with one CMX500 OBT-based setup | Vehicle-level OTA installation effects are not stated [17][18]. |
### 限制
The passages directly support automotive signaling relevance mainly for NG eCall and hybrid eCall, while general LTE/5G/WLAN CMX500 capabilities are not explicitly labeled automotive-specific outside eCall [24][25][6].
R&S AREG800A is an automotive radar echo generator for dynamic artificial object generation, but it is not described as an RF signaling tester in the provided passages [13][26].
【推論】For automotive programs beyond eCall, the strongest CMX500 capability set to evaluate first is LTE/5G/WLAN signaling plus application, audio, throughput, protocol and OTA testing, because CMX500 covers these functions and automotive eCall already uses CMX500 as the radio communication tester [6][24][25].

| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G | R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA098 | Simulate PSAP, validate NG eCall voice and data transmission, and verify EN 17240:2024 implementation compliance | Third-party certification report details are not stated [25]. |

| OTA validation of multi-radio modules | R&S CMX500 OBT with MVG or Bluetest OTA systems | Run 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling with one CMX500 OBT-based setup | Vehicle-level OTA installation effects are not stated [17][18]. |
### 限制
The passages directly support automotive signaling relevance mainly for NG eCall and hybrid eCall, while general LTE/5G/WLAN CMX500 capabilities are not explicitly labeled automotive-specific outside eCall [24][25][6].
R&S AREG800A is an automotive radar echo generator for dynamic artificial object generation, but it is not described as an RF signaling tester in the provided passages [13][26].
【推論】For automotive programs beyond eCall, the strongest CMX500 capability set to evaluate first is LTE/5G/WLAN signaling plus application, audio, throughput, protocol and OTA testing, because CMX500 covers these functions and automotive eCall already uses CMX500 as the radio communication tester [6][24][25].

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity › 重點摘要
- 來源未標示發布日期；raw frontmatter `created: 2026-09-11`，本文 ingest 日期為 2026-09-15。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱在最終 IEEE standard ratification 之前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。
- 展示情境：[[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80，Fira Gran Via Barcelona，hall 5。
- 測試對象：[[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device / prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

- 來源稱 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 延續 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 的 core PHY parameters：supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz、channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz、4096QAM modulation、[[MLO]]。
- 來源列出 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的新 testing hurdles，包括 [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）與 [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）。
- dRU measurements 被描述為可驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness。
- UEQM analysis 被描述為可評估 test device 是否能依 specified modulation coding scheme（MCS）combinations 正確 adapt modulation。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 modular、powerful one-box signaling tester，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR]] SA/NSA、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、Direct-to-Cell（[[D2C]] / [[DTC]]）與 WLAN including [[Wi‑Fi 7]] and [[Wi‑Fi 8]]。

建議主軸：Automotive signaling test should prioritize R&S CMX500-based NG eCall / hybrid eCall compliance and PSAP simulation first, then extend to LTE/5G/WLAN signaling, OTA, throughput, audio, protocol and coexistence testing where the vehicle connectivity design requires it [24][25][6].
### 推薦先賣
**NG eCall / hybrid eCall signaling validation** is the strongest automotive-specific capability because the R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 supports NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions and PSAP simulation for EN 17240:2024 [25].
**Hybrid eCall compliance** is important because EN 18052 requires combining different transmission paths and protocols so the eCall reliably reaches its destination [10].
**Voice, data, MSD and GNSS-related eCall validation** is important because manufacturers need to validate call triggering, MSD transmission, GNSS positioning and intelligible voice quality [10].
**Cellular and WLAN signaling coverage** is important because the R&S CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD and WLAN signaling including 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn and 2x2 MIMO [6].
**OTA signaling** is important where the device or module must be validated through an antenna system, because CMX500 OBT integrations support 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling in MVG OTA systems and 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA, LTE and WLAN testing in Bluetest RTS systems [17][18].
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 + eCall software | NG eCall, hybrid eCall, PSAP simulation, voice and data transmission validation | R&S CMX-KA098 for EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 PSAP scenarios; R&S CMX-KA099 for EN 18052:2025 PSAP scenarios; R&S CMX-KA09x updated eCall evaluation solution | This is the clearest automotive signaling fit because the sources directly tie CMX500 to NG eCall and hybrid eCall testing | [24][25] | Pricing, exact bundle contents and supported regional variants are not stated. |
| R&S CMX500 | LTE/5G cellular signaling, application-layer testing, protocol testing and RF measurements | 400 MHz to 8 GHz RF frequency range; LTE, 5G and Wi‑Fi UE signaling; power, frequency, spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER, MIMO, IP throughput, video, audio and protocol test | This covers the main connected-device signaling and measurement layers that automotive communication modules may need | [5] | Test cases, standard release, bandwidth, MIMO layers, OTA/conducted setup, automation interface, limits and uncertainty are not stated [5]. |
| R&S CMX500 | LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN, throughput, BLER, PER, IMS/audio and automation | NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements; LTE signaling and measurements; WLAN signaling and TX measurements; fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput, PER, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, graphical scripting, Python XLAPI and SCPI | This is the broadest single signaling platform in the passages for cellular, WLAN, RF, application and automation work | [6] | Automotive-specific certification scope is only directly stated for eCall, not for every CMX500 cellular/WLAN feature. |
| R&S CMX500 OBT with MVG OTA systems | 4G/5G/WLAN OTA signaling through antenna measurement systems | Full WLAN OTA signaling including Wi‑Fi 7 / IEEE 802.11be; 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling; 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA, RedCap and LTE FDD/TDD support | This is suitable when the automotive device must be evaluated over the air rather than only by conducted RF connection | [1][17] | The passages do not state automotive-specific OTA test cases or vehicle-level antenna chamber requirements. |
| R&S CMX500 OBT with Bluetest RTS | Reverberation-chamber OTA validation for LTE, 5G NR and WLAN | 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA EN-DC, LTE and WLAN a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be with Wi‑Fi 7 320 MHz bandwidth support | This is suitable for multi-technology OTA validation using a single tester and reverberation test system | [18] | The passages do not state automotive-specific pass/fail criteria or car-module certification coverage. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall over 4G/5G | R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA098 | Simulate PSAP, validate NG eCall voice and data transmission, and verify EN 17240:2024 implementation compliance | Third-party certification report details are not stated [25]. |
| Hybrid eCall fallback | R&S CMX500 + R&S CMX-KA09x / CMX-KA099 | Validate EN 18052:2025 hybrid eCall behavior where coverage or service quality degradation triggers fallback to classic CS eCall 2G/3G paths | Exact network degradation profiles and pass/fail limits are not stated [10][24]. |
| Automotive connectivity module RF/signaling regression | R&S CMX500 | Cover LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, BLER, PER, throughput, IMS/audio and protocol-level needs | Automotive-specific regression suites are not stated [6]. |
| WLAN-heavy infotainment or connectivity designs | R&S CMX500 | Test WLAN signaling and TX measurements across 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn and 2x2 MIMO | Automotive infotainment-specific conformance coverage is not stated [6]. |
| OTA validation of multi-radio modules | R&S CMX500 OBT with MVG or Bluetest OTA systems | Run 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling with one CMX500 OBT-based setup | Vehicle-level OTA installation effects are not stated [17][18]. |
### 限制
The passages directly support automotive signaling relevance mainly for NG eCall and hybrid eCall, while general LTE/5G/WLAN CMX500 capabilities are not explicitly labeled automotive-specific outside eCall [24][25][6].
R&S AREG800A is an automotive radar echo generator for dynamic artificial object generation, but it is not described as an RF signaling tester in the provided passages [13][26].
【推論】For automotive programs beyond eCall, the strongest CMX500 capability set to evaluate first is LTE/5G/WLAN signaling plus application, audio, throughput, protocol and OTA testing, because CMX500 covers these functions and automotive eCall already uses CMX500 as the radio communication tester [6][24][25].

UAV signaling test solution › CMX500 可涵蓋的 signaling test 範圍
依 [[Signaling test solution]]，[[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 400 MHz 至 8 GHz，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test。來源列出的測試類別包含：

- 基本 RF 量測：Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

使用限制：來源未說明 test case、standard version、release、channel bandwidth、MIMO layers、OTA / conducted setup、automation interface、pass / fail limit 或 measurement uncertainty。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 官網新聞稿，說明 [[MVG]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full WLAN signaling test functionality（含 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]）整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，使 [[MVG]] OTA test systems / multiprobe measurement systems 可在單一 antenna measurement system 內進行 4G、5G 與 WLAN OTA signaling testing。來源未標示發布日期與文件版次；raw frontmatter 的 created 為 2026-09-11。

R&S CMX500 OBT › Bluetest RTS / OTA test 語境
依 [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 可與 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）及 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 搭配。
- 支援使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 在 Bluetest RTS 中執行 [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）與 [[LTE]] testing。
- [[Bluetest]] 也將較早的 [[WLAN]] stations / access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）integrated testing capabilities 擴充到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 320 MHz bandwidth support。
- 來源將此整合定位為 single tester and reverberation test system 的 multi-technology validation path。

Hybrid eCall testing › R&S solution context
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]：

- 測試方案基於 [[R&S CMX500]] radio communication tester。
- [[R&S CMX-KA09x]] updated eCall evaluation solution 支援 [[EN 18052]]:2025 與 [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026 compliance。
- [[R&S CMX-KA099]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 18052]]:2025。
- [[R&S CMX-KA098]] completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios according to [[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026。
- [[cetecom advanced]] conducted certification testing。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S AREG800A]] Automotive Radar Echo Generator 的 specifications，文件編號 `PD 3609.8015.22`，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`，文件標題為 `AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`，Copyright `© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。

[[R&S AREG800A]] 的 echo generator type 為 `dynamic artificial object generation`。Echo generation concept 分為：

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
- `digital`：針對 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 `air gap value`；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 在環境溫度下儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格資料定義：

- `Specifications with limits`：代表保證的產品效能，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：代表保證的產品效能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Data without tolerance limits is not binding`；文件 `subject to change`。
